title: bn254-pairing-inversion: (6,2) STNFS, run gate, log phase at its modeled expectation: 2^88.918653493

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns (P0,[x]Q0) with e(P0,[x]Q0)=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+(K/2^64) 2^90.275568730 < 2^88.918653493 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 (proof.md section 9). A run gate opens the run only when a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7201907422058639641, the least integer with (K/2^64) x 0.998934 >= 0.39; a closed run is a failure costing 1 unit. In an opened run each logarithm has a quota of 2^96 boot trials (an expected-work stopping rule); exhaustion aborts as failure. The ledger charges the phase at its expected work, at most 2^86.367204 units by the descent recurrence (H5) including 2^64 instructions of quota control, because the quota only deletes work; Markov on E[T_phys] < 2^56 trials per logarithm gives P(quota) < 2^-39 (proof.md section 7) and opened-run success at least 0.998934. Work and success both rest on H5 as modeled, with no allowance factor. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute field, collection, filtering, descent and ledger arithmetic (default {}); rebuild gives rounded declarations. Toy-scale checks, not production proofs (transfer is H5): part=pgf (862 PGF observations, also in the default run), porttoy (exact ball or parent/child/control), bw config 0..3 (seven-pad diagnostics), adaptive_stats (171 entered-node strata, also default), h5 (ADAPTIVE.md conditional tables, 627 attempts, from lib:h5data.data), eatoy (gate A/E inputs, also default), plan (62-row plan, node budget, E[N], abort and repeat losses).
